maria: starting config-only push now — routing priority + batch cap + timeout trim. Deploy bot: https://deploys.redwood.internal/1755554321 :rocket:
maria: change window 02:00-03:00 UTC. micro-canary 0.8% targeted to europe-west-1 (latency-sensitive tenants). model pinned to v2.3.1 for 12h. no code.
deploy-bot: rollout kicked: stage=canary pct=0.8 region=europe-west-1 config=cfg/2026-03-21/hedge-routing-slim.json
sam: what are the exact delta numbers?
maria: request_timeout_ms 1050 -> 950, max_batch_size 70 -> 45, batching_window_ms 18 -> 10. routing: prefer low_latency_pool when load>60%.
jules: last time we trimmed window that hard we saw small p95 regressions; add autobackout rule: errors>0.6% OR p99>baseline*1.4 for 6m triggers rollback. attach runbook: https://wiki.redwood/ops/config-rollbacks
maria: rule applied and pager to #eng-oncall. yaml excerpt:
```yaml
routing:
  prefer: low_latency_pool
  activation_load_pct: 60
limits:
  max_batch_size: 45
  request_timeout_ms: 950
batching_window_ms: 10
```
deploy-bot: canary deployed to europe-west-1, pct=0.8, health checks running.
observability-bot: initial metrics -> p50=90ms p95=260ms p99=500ms errors=0.04% cost_delta=-0.7%
sam: p99 slightly below baseline, good. keep an eye on kv-cache ops.
jules: set kv_miss alert: >15% increase sustained 5m.
maria: added. progressing to 3% in 12m if stable. release note draft: "Config-only: bias routing toward low-latency pool under load, reduce max_batch_size to 45, shorten batching window to 10ms, and trim request timeout to 950ms. Scoped micro-canary to europe-west-1. Model pinned v2.3.1 for 12h. Auto-rollback on error/p99/kvmiss thresholds"
deploy-bot: 0.8% healthy after 10m — p95 +1ms, errors stable. advancing to 3%.
observability-bot: alerting enabled, dashboard pinned to thread.
ops-oncall: oncall acknowledged, will escalate if rollback triggers.
maria: will post final status after full rollout or immediately if rollback happens. :thumbsup:
